The leaf appears severely diseased with irregular dark patches. No clear concentric rings visible. Candidates: Late Blight, Early Blight, Phytophthora Blight, Gray Mold.

- Early Blight: Shows concentric ring patterns — does not match.
- Phytophthora Blight: Reference shows whole plant wilting — not matching.
- Gray Mold: Shows fruit with gray mold — not matching.
- Leaf Mold: Yellow spots on green leaf — not matching.
- Alternaria: Stem canker images — not matching.
- Septoria Leaf Blotch: Small circular spots — not matching.

The test image is a very close visual match to the Late Blight CDDM references — same photographic style, same gray background, same large irregular dark necrotic lesions pattern.
